context.objective_statement: Plan a neighborhood volunteer checklist for families, with a $500 budget and an indoor rain option.

turns.question: Synthetic A1 model-route inspection: which information is missing before this volunteer checklist can be examined?

blocks.text:
The supplied context lacks a draft checklist and settled details for:
• Users and purpose: organizers, families, or both; intended volunteer outcome.
• Scope: activities, participant numbers and ages, location, date, and duration.
• Budget: what the $500 covers, cost estimates, and donations.
• Rain option: indoor activity, venue availability, capacity, accessibility, and permissions.
• Responsibilities: task owners, supervision, safety and allergy constraints, and who confirms arrangements.
• Review basis: relevant rules, checklist format, and criteria for readiness.

A partial draft can receive an advisory gap review now; all arrangements need not be settled first. Mark assumptions and unconfirmed details explicitly. Review would not establish approval or readiness.
Can you share a draft to examine, or should we first clarify who the checklist serves and what it should accomplish?

turns.question: Synthetic A1 model-route inspection: which of those missing inputs should I clarify first, and why?

blocks.text: Clarify users and purpose first: who will use the checklist, and what should their volunteering accomplish? These choices guide which tasks belong, who owns them, and what makes the checklist useful.

Next, clarify activities, participant numbers and ages, and timing. Then consider supervision and safety, indoor venue suitability, and what the $500 covers together—these constraints may change the activity. The supplied context does not settle these details; leave final formatting until later.
Should the checklist serve organizers, participating families, or both—and what volunteer activity or benefit do you have in mind?
